name: e-Mobility Systems
description:
Overview of transportation electrification, architecture of electric vehicles (BEV, HEV, PHEV), key subsystems - traction motor, inverter, battery, controller.
Scalar (V/f) control of induction motors, Vector control (FOC) of PMSM and IM, Trapezoidal control for BLDC, Sensorless control methods.
DC-DC converters, Voltage source inverters, converter selection for IM, PMSM, BLDC drives, Modulation techniques: SPWM, SVPWM.
Powertrain configurations: single vs multi-motor systems, Vehicle Dynamics Control (traction, stability, regen), regenerative braking.
Battery technologies: Li-ion, LiFePO4, Battery modeling and characteristics, State of Charge (SOC) and State of Health (SOH) estimation, Battery Management System (BMS) functions, Battery charging techniques (on-board/off-board)
Emerging trends - wireless charging, V2G systems, SiC/GaN converters in e-Mobility systems.
